crossRefs.note: The residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: The residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
translations.bsb: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the villages of Judah, each on his own inheritance.
translations.kjv: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
translations.asv: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
